verdict.rationale: Trivy offers natural-language operation through its official trivy-mcp plugin. The plugin advertises 'Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language' and runs an MCP server that connects Trivy's scanning to VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools. However, the natural-language layer depends on installing a separate plugin and on an external AI client, so it is not native to the core CLI. Missing for 10: natural-language operation built into the core Trivy CLI, in-depth documentation of which natural-language commands or scan types are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language scanning works as claimed.
